detail.longDescription: I'm building a phone voice agent with the OpenAI Realtime API ( gpt-realtime ). On noisy calls it sometimes mishears the caller (e.g. it hears «عندك مطبخ؟» "do you have a kitchen?" when the caller said «عندك مسبح؟» "do you have a pool?") and answers the wrong question. I want to check how confident the transcription of the caller's turn was, and only let the model respond if confidence is high enough . Otherwise I'll play a fixed "could you repeat that?" message. My session config: { "type": "session.update", "session": { "model": "gpt-realtime", "input_audio_transcription": { "model": "gpt-4o-transcribe", "prompt": "A phone call in Arabic or English. Transcribe in the language spoken." }, "turn_detection": { "type": "server_vad", "create_response": false } } } With create_response: false , I wait for conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed and then send response.create myself. Can I get logprobs (or any confidence) for the input audio transcription in a Realtime session? If yes, how do I enable it and in which event do they appear?
